@duediligenceguy Global population doesn't grow that fast, but since so few own any Dogecoin, the demand for Doge may grow much faster. Anyway, the longer term point of Doge is to be spent, not hoarded as digital gold like Bitcoin.

@duediligenceguy Dogecoin is disinflationary - a fixed 5bn coins are minted each year, giving an inflation rate of 4% and dropping. That keeps Doge fast and cheap for funds transfer, and it clearly hasn't stopped the price from rising. Many coins are uncapped, including Ethereum.
